lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: In this world, everybody believes in God.

lines.speaker: huss
lines.text: Huss... huss... huss...

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Problem is, there's zero proof. Not a footprint. Not a receipt.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Scientists tried. Telescopes, microscopes, one guy even licked a meteorite. Nothing.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But nobody could prove He didn't exist either. Total stalemate. For centuries.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Then the philosophers had a breakthrough. They called it...

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: the Burger Wager.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: If you believe in God and you're wrong? You lose nothing.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: If you believe and you're right? Infinite rewards. Forever.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But if you don't believe, and He's real? Infinite punishment. Forever.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Infinite heaven, versus a little effort. The math was perfect.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And it worked. Ninety-nine point nine percent of the world didn't just believe. They went full religious.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Prayer apps. Church drive-thrus. Babies baptized before they could even blink.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And then there was me. The last non-believer on Earth.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Because the argument just didn't sit right with me.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: You can't flip a belief switch because someone offered you a prize. I'm not a robot.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: You can bet on a team you think will lose. Doesn't mean you believe they'll win.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: But everyone was worried about me.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Sweetie, we pray for you every single night.

lines.speaker: bro
lines.text: Bro, they're gonna roast you. Literally.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And honestly, I didn't wanna burn either.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: So I did the research. Every counterargument. Every loophole.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I couldn't beat the odds. Infinity always wins.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: So I gave in. I believed.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And you know what? It wasn't so bad.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: My life had purpose. I was happy. I had a church family that brought me casseroles.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Sixty years passed. And then, I died.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I opened my eyes in a white room.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: I was right! He's real! The wager paid off!

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Then I saw everyone else. Being thrown into the fire.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: My pastor. My mom. The guy who invented the wager.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: I left no evidence. On purpose.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: I don't reward belief. I reward warranted belief.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: You had no reason to believe in me. So you shouldn't have.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: Turns out, it was never a two-option bet.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: There were infinite possible gods, wanting infinite possible things. We only thought of one.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: We all burned.

lines.speaker: narr
lines.text: And the worst part? I was right the first time.
